_om: Games that are alike, in groups, each with a short reason in every edition. The page of a game lists the others in its groups under «Prøv også» (scripts/rusj.mjs: lesFamilier, provOgsa). The closest groups first: a page shows at most four games, in this order. An 18+ game is only ever suggested from another 18+ game; a game that an edition does not have is left out there. No brand names in the reasons.
